Our Story

Where Beauty Meets Confidence

Our Story

A decade of beauty, trust, and transformation.

Lumière Beauty Studio began with a simple belief: that beauty is not about following trends, but about revealing the best version of yourself. Founded over a decade ago, we started as a small studio with big ambitions — to create a space where every woman feels heard, valued, and beautifully transformed.

Today, Lumière has grown into one of New Delhi's most trusted beauty destinations, serving thousands of clients who return not just for the results, but for the experience. From everyday hair and skin care to complete bridal transformations, we bring the same level of care, expertise, and attention to every appointment.

Our name, Lumière — meaning light — reflects our commitment to helping your natural beauty shine through. Every treatment, every consultation, and every interaction is designed to illuminate what makes you uniquely beautiful.

Our Philosophy

Beauty, Reimagined

Three principles that guide everything we do.

Individual Beauty

We don't believe in one-size-fits-all. Every treatment is tailored to your unique features, skin type, and personal style.

Mindful Care

We choose products and techniques that are as kind to you as they are effective — premium, professional, and thoughtfully selected.

Holistic Experience

Beauty is more than the result — it's how you feel during the process. We create a calming, restorative experience at every visit.

Our Approach

How we create your experience.

Every visit to Lumière follows a thoughtful, personalized process designed to deliver results you can see and feel.

01

Consult

We begin with a one-on-one consultation to understand your needs, preferences, and goals.

02

Based on your consultation, we design a treatment plan tailored specifically to you.

03

Our experienced professionals bring the plan to life with precision and care.

04

We provide guidance and recommendations to help you maintain your results at home.
